methodology: Reported 13F long holdings value is an equity exposure proxy, not verified total institution equity AUM. Turnover proxy is min(estimated buys,estimated sells) / average reported non-option portfolio value, annualized by elapsed days; trade prices approximated using preceding period value/share, or current for new holdings. Corporate actions, market changes, non-13F assets, confidential treatment and intraperiod trades cause errors. Do not treat as actual turnover.
style_methodology: Future point-in-time weighted fundamental factor scores across holdings; no style assigned without reliable fundamentals.
orientation_methodology: Active/passive mix is computed from independently verified non-overlapping underlying fund equity assets at the same report date. Shares refer to classified fund assets only; institution-wide percentages require complete equity AUM and coverage.
